The provided JSON payload contains a comprehensive summary of the results obtained from a machine learning experiment. The summary encompasses several key aspects:

* **Model Performance:**  The performance of various machine learning models (KNN, RF, XGBoost, SVM, DT) is evaluated based on their Mean Squared Error (MSE) and R-squared (R²) values. The KNN model emerges as the best performer with an MSE of 0.012810 and an R² of 0.81717.
* **Incremental Feature Analysis:** This analysis demonstrates how the performance of different models changes as more features are added. It reveals a trend where adding more features generally improves model performance, although the rate of improvement may vary across models.

The summary also includes a text payload in 'results_summary.txt' that provides a detailed textual representation of these findings.

Overall, this JSON payload offers a concise and informative overview of the machine learning experiment results, enabling users to quickly understand the key insights and trends.
